messages:
Morgan: Heads up — after the OOB BMC v2.14.0 rollout in us-west1 this morning ~10% of GPU nodes are dropping KVM and serial for ~30-90s intermittently. Noticed it during a large GPU provisioning run.
Dan: Seeing same. Affected nodes are mostly racking with pcie-gen4 GPUs, boot stalls, then come back. No kernel oops on the host, just OOB disconnects.
Priya: Can you paste the failing node IDs? I’ll cross-check with firmware image digest.
Morgan: node-uw1-gpu-042, node-uw1-gpu-089, node-uw1-gpu-173. infra-bot posted the rollout at 08:03:12 UTC: `release/bmc-v2.14.0`
infra-bot: Deployment note — staged rollout to us-west1, 25% -> 50% -> 100%. Canary passed at 08:02:50.
Alex: Quick check — BMC change log shows new IPMI bridge timeout tweak and SecureBoot toggle handling fix. Could the bridge timeout be too aggressive for our serial proxies?
Dan: I grabbed serial logs before disconnection: `ipmitool -H 10.1.2.3 -I lanplus sol deactivate` shows repeated `SOL session closed by remote` entries right before kernel rebinds.
Priya: SecureBoot toggle in BMC might be flipping for nodes that had residual UEFI vars from previous staging. If BMC flips secureboot state on reprovision, the host firmware can lock and BMC closes out-of-band sessions until state resolves.
Morgan: That matches: nodes that recovered had a delayed EFI variable write on next boot. So provisioning jobs hit a 60s timeout and retried. That explains transient capacity hit.
Ops-oncall: Current impact: ~9 nodes out of 120 GPU nodes in us-west1 had repeated OOB disconnects causing provisioning retries. No service-level outage yet but scheduling latency for queued GPU jobs increased ~18%.
Alex: Suggested immediate mitigation: pause the BMC rollout to remaining batches, and push a soft watchdog config rollback to earlier timeout (v2.13.7 behavior). Also add a temporary routing rule to prefer eu-west or us-central pools for new heavy provisioning runs.
Morgan: Agreed — pausing now. Can someone run `rbacctl reroute --pool=eu-west --flow=provision-heavy` for the next 2h?
Dan: Done. Reroute created and active.
Priya: I can whip a quick script to clear EFI variable remnants before provisioning reboot:
```
ssh root@$NODE "efibootmgr -v; efivar --list | grep -i test && efibootmgr -c"
# then trigger a controlled reboot
```
Use only on repro nodes.
Ops-oncall: Adding a short advisory to the cluster incidents channel and tagging capacity team. :warning:
Morgan: Action list: 1) Hold rollout (Alex) 2) Re-route provisioning (Dan) 3) Run EFI-clean job on repro nodes (Priya) 4) Collect BMC IPMI logs and SOL traces for all affected nodes (Morgan) 5) Postmortem if rollout resumes.
Alex: I'll open a rollback PR for the BMC timeout change and include the secureboot toggle as a known-risk flag in the release notes.
Priya: FYI cost note — routing to other regions will burn cross-region egress and might push reserved GPU usage over threshold if sustained. Recommend communicate to bizops if >1h.
Morgan: Good call. Ops-oncall, set a 60m timer and notify finance if we still have >5 repro nodes.
Ops-oncall: Timer set. Notifying finance if beyond 60m.
Dan: Uploading collected logs to /mnt/logs/incident-3990012345/ (permission: eng-infra-read).
Morgan: Thanks. We'll reconvene in 30m or on updates. :thumbsup:
